Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the asks we discussed: 

- Decision criteria: latency <200ms for 2k token bursts, strong SLOs for availability, and clear data isolation controls for regulated PII flows.
- Primary use-case: real-time customer support routing + automated compliance summaries for high-risk accounts.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Thomas Briggs (economic buyer, payments lead), Alice Jensen (security), Procurement team.

Immediate next steps we agreed on: 
1) You to share a stakeholder map (contact + role + decision influence) — attached template for convenience.
2) Intro to Alice Jensen (security) and procurement alias so we can send SOC2 evidence and a short security brief.
3) Redwood to prepare a one-page ROI talk track and a tailored deck showing latency/cost tradeoffs and a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

I attached a stakeholder-mapping template (Finovate_MALM_map.xlsx) and a first-pass meeting deck. We'll circle back with a proposed calendar: target is a 30-min intro between our SE and your security team next week.

If you can confirm Thomas's availability windows and the right procurement contact, I'll lock in the materials and loop in our SE.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround and the filled map, Oliver. Looping in Sean (sales manager), Monica (solutions lead), and Dev (SE) to prep materials.

Monica/Dev — please see Oliver's stakeholder map. Priorities: 
- Prepare a one-page ROI memo that quantifies token cost savings vs current vendor and a short TCO table.
- Draft a 15-min security brief (SOC2 scope, encryption at rest/in transit, key management options) to send to Alice; attach if we can.
- SE ask: prepare a short runbook for integration work (API, expected latency numbers, sample payload sizes).

Oliver — can you please introduce us to Alice (security) and procurement@finovatebank.com? If Thomas (VP Payments) is available for a 15-min intro next Tue (5/26) or Wed (5/27) morning PST, we'd like to coordinate a brief pricing/roadmap alignment.

We'll update the MAP and send the ROI one-pager and draft SOW by EOD Monday.

Thanks all —
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-23T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Adding some technical notes for the thread (so Monica and Marissa can reference when drafting the security brief):

- SOC2: we can provide SOC2 Type II report and a short security checklist that maps controls to Finovate's questions.
- Data handling: support for request-level encryption and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) on our Private offering; hosted option supports strict tenant isolation and encrypted tokenization of PII by default.
- Latency: we'll provide observed p50/p95 numbers for 2k token payloads on dedicated capacity; expect ~120-180ms p95 depending on batch config.
- Integration: REST API + streaming; example payloads and sample code will be in the runbook.

I'll prepare the SOC2 stub and a short tech runbook to attach to the security brief and the SOW draft.

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW draft, technical appendix placeholder)


Dev
